text: Parent Stephanie Krizan petitioned CFAUSD to remove Preston Norton's Neanderthal Opens the Door to the Universe, citing concerns about vulgarities, sexual descriptions and drug use. A review committee decided the book should not be banned and that no action should be taken. The board nevertheless voted 5–2 to require parental consent for its use as optional reading in classes.
